aj: Quick note — running the sampleapp in JSON_MODE we hit a parity bug between Node and Python SDKs when auth retries occur. Node ends up returning double-encoded arrays from fncall tools.
Mia: Ugh, can you paste a tiny repro/log?
aj: Repro steps: set JSON_MODE=on, trigger an auth 401 on the first request, SDK retry kicks in. Paste of log: ```
WARN retry-wrapper: got 401, reauthing
DEBUG helper: original tool output: [{"id":1,"result":{"items":["a","b"]}}]
DEBUG retry-wrapper: returning stringified payload: "[\"{\"id\":1,\"result\":{\"items\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}}\"]"
```
Sam: That log nails it — the Node SDK's fncall normalization wraps a parsed array into a string when the retry wrapper receives a raw string. Python parsed earlier so it stays as an object. In short: parse/serialize ordering mismatch.
Tess: Is this the helper that coerces single objects into arrays for schema compatibility? Might be interacting with the retry middleware.
aj: Yep. The problematic flow: 1) service returns text body that is valid JSON array, 2) helper's middleware stringifies to keep trace, 3) retry wrapper replays that string and then helper coerces -> ends up with double-escaped JSON inside array.
Mia: Minimal fix options: - stop stringifying in retry path and keep parsed object, or - make helper tolerant of already-stringified payloads.
Sam: Prefer changing retry-wrapper to store the parsed body in metadata and rehydrate the original parsed object on replay. Less surface area. But add a unit test to lock parity.
aj: I'll open a tiny PR to change retry-wrapper to preserve parsed body + add a sampleapp smoketest for JSON_MODE.
ci-bot: unit tests (node-sdk) failed — 3 tests in fncall-helper-suite.
Tess: Can we add a cross-sdk integration test in the sampleapp CI matrix? This keeps regressions from slipping between implementations.
aj: Yep, I'll add an extra matrix entry that runs Node & Python sampleapps against a local mock that forces a 401 then 200. Will link PR once ready.
Mia: Thanks — please add changelog note and tag eng-ml for awareness (schema validation folks).
aj: Will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/456 (WIP)
Mia: Nice. Follow-up: also check behavior when schema expects an object but gets an array — we had a related coercion rule that might still mis-handle edge cases.
Sam: Good call. Add explicit test vectors for array-vs-object schema coercion.
aj: On it.
